notes:
Fixed

  • Configure World Map would not save anything. Seconds per Hex declared min="0.2" against step="0.5", so the only values the browser accepted were 0.2, 0.7, 1.2, 1.7 and so on — the stored default of 3 was not among them, and no whole number could be typed in. One invalid field blocks an HTML form from submitting at all, so that single box was quietly stopping every other Hex Travel and Encounters setting from being saved. The field now steps in halves from 0.5 to 30, a value stored off that grid is snapped before it reaches the form, and the save clamps to the same range. Present since hex travel arrived in 1.3.0.
